Show them: the question, the decision and who decides, the ambiguities still open, every alternative, and every criterion with its definition, scale and direction of preference, naming any two criteria that overlap. When they answer, call frame_confirm again with decision set to their answer, confirmed_by set to the name they go by, and confirmation_text set to their reply word for word. If they answered for only part of it, set scope to the part, or to two parts joined with +, for example frame+criteria. On revise, make the changes they asked for, then call frame_confirm with no decision to ask again.
